description: This file defines a set of API functions for authentication operations such as registration, login, MFA verification, token refresh, and logout, using an API client to communicate with backend endpoints.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant user with email and password.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login step 1 by validating credentials and optionally retrieving MFA info.

methods.name: verifyMfa
methods.description: Verifies MFA with userId and OTP, and retrieves tokens.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token.
